title: High cyclomatic complexity: spawn (CCN=16)
detail: `spawn` has a cyclomatic complexity of 16 over 99 lines (L1149–1291). Functions this complex are hard to test exhaustively, tend to accumulate subtle conditional bugs, and resist refactoring. Suggested fix: extract cohesive sub-operations into smaller, named functions with clear preconditions.

title: File exceeds 1000 lines (2379 lines)
detail: File is 2379 lines, well above the 1000-line maintainability threshold. Large files typically contain many unrelated concerns and make code review and change-isolation harder. Suggested fix: split into smaller modules by responsibility.

title: Broad exception caught (bare `except Exception`) at 10 sites (L626,L1193,L1248,L1286,L1302,L1787)
detail: Multiple `except Exception` handlers use `excutils.save_and_reraise_exception()`, which is acceptable OpenStack idiom. A few handlers only log without re-raising. Suggested fix: review non-reraise handlers and narrow the exception type where the specific exceptions from the callee are known.

title: Inconsistent return statements: 1 functions mix explicit/implicit returns (L2239)
detail: Some functions return a value on some paths and fall off the end (returning `None` implicitly) on others. Callers that rely on the return value may receive `None` unexpectedly. Suggested fix: add an explicit `return` on all branches or refactor to raise on error paths.

title: Exception context suppressed: 8 `raise` statements without `from` (L371,L480,L1316,L1912,L1999,L2023)
detail: Raising a new exception inside an `except` block without `raise NewExc() from exc` discards the original traceback, making debugging harder. Suggested fix: use `raise NewExc() from exc` or `raise NewExc() from None` if suppression is intentional.
